scope: Read-only native passenger history selection after the two successful cash trips
observed: Native Ktor fetched selected historical ride and receipt with HTTP 200, then subsequent dashboard catch-up reads occurred; selected detail could not remain visible to the bounded review
source_finding: MobileAppCoordinator loadPassengerRideHistoryDetail returns selected fields only on its immediate result; later authenticatedProductState reconstructs defaults without selection intent. Driver history follows the same pattern.
planned_regression_scope: Passenger refresh retains selection while rereading changed cash status
Driver refresh retains selection while rereading newly submitted feedback
Revoked selected-history access returns explicit error without stale details
Sign out/sign in clears navigation ownership
A history result arriving after sign out must not install old selected data
qualification: Successful v15 core trip/receipt/style checks retain their scope; they do not accept this history navigation failure.
